title: A town 14 miles from Dallas has no clean drinking water. She’s trying to fill the gap

title: Today on Texas Standard: ‘Deep in the Heart 2’ explores the rivers and aquifers that sustain Texas
summary: Texas may be known for wide-open land, but its rivers, springs and underground aquifers make life here possible. A new documentary narrated by Ethan Hawke explores those water systems, the...
content: Texas may be known for wide-open land, but its rivers, springs and underground aquifers make life here possible. A new documentary narrated by Ethan Hawke explores those water systems, the wildlife that depends on them and the pressures they face. Source
